skill.name: Hallowed Mist
skill.description: Gwen summons mist that protects her from enemies outside of it. She can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.

skill.name: Skip 'n Slash
skill.description: Gwen dashes a short distance then gains Attack Speed, attack range, and magic damage <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> for a few seconds. If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.

skill.name: Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow
skill.description: Yunara gains decaying Move Speed and becomes Ghosted. While in her Transcendent State she instead dashes in a direction.
